title: A long suit with no high honors
author_notes: Reviewed during EC-033 implementation; see docs/COACHING_REVIEW.md. Independent hand; ratings are authored judgments, not probabilities or guaranteed outcomes.

feedback.title: Length can create unwanted winners
feedback.summary: Seven Clubs make zero more fragile than the lack of high honors suggests, especially if Clubs become trump.
points: Length: seven Clubs can survive after higher Clubs have been played.
Risk: if Clubs become trump, even low Clubs may take tricks.
Trump is unknown; neither late winners nor safe losers are guaranteed.

feedback.title: Respect the long suit
feedback.summary: Entering keeps options open with seven Clubs. Length offers potential, but it is not seven safe tricks.
points: Control: you hold none of the top four Clubs.
Probable: some long-suit cards may be promoted after higher cards are used.
Risk: a different trump or losing the lead can disrupt that plan.
